name: canvas-course-builder
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：canvas-course-builder。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Scaffold complete Canvas LMS course structures from specs, templates, or existing courses. Creates modules, pages, assignments, and discussions in bulk. Use when asked to "build a course", "scaffold modules", "create course structure", "set up a new course", or "copy course structure".
